title: Maternal mortality, 1751-2013
claim_summary: Maternal mortality declined sharply in representative countries.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser 2016p, based partly on data from Claudia Hanson of Gapminder.
original_dataset: Source-improved partial reconstruction: Gapminder GD010 gapdata010.xls/gapdoc010.pdf recovered for Sweden, United States, and Malaysia where available; complete Roser 2016p OWID/World Bank 2015 machine-readable vintage remains unrecovered for Ethiopia and short post-Gapminder tails.
provenance_summary: Recovered Gapminder GD010 workbook and documentation support Sweden, United States, and Malaysia where available. The exact Roser 2016p OWID/World Bank 2015 machine-readable vintage was not recovered, so Ethiopia and short post-Gapminder tails are current OWID successor/equivalent fills only.
source_caveats: Do not treat Ethiopia values as verified book-era Roser 2016p/World Bank 2015 values; Ethiopia is absent from recovered Gapminder GD010.
Do not treat short post-Gapminder tails as verified book-era Roser 2016p/World Bank 2015 values; the supplement remains unrecovered.
Do not promote beyond partial_match/source_improved_partial_reconstruction without recovering and validating the exact book-era Roser 2016p/World Bank 2015 source vintage.
notes: Confidence is medium-high for the recovered Gapminder source component and lower for Ethiopia and short post-Gapminder tails. Ethiopia and tail rows use current OWID successor/equivalent fill and are explicitly not verified book-era Roser 2016p/World Bank 2015 values because that machine-readable vintage remains unrecovered.
